title: Bain Capital Griffin Aircraft Fund

toc.text: Aircraft deliveries are recovering from pandemic-era lows, with narrowbodies driving long-term growth amid persistent supply constraints.
An elevated replacement cycle favors aircraft lessors, supporting long-term lease demand, asset utilization, and residual values.
Portfolio composition further diversified QoQ through the acquisition of 9x1 assets added in connection with our inaugural securitization.
Our existing portfolio is comprised of 15x aircraft1 and 5x engines3, built across three high-impact transactions.
